name: vscode-copilot-huckleberry
description: A VS Code GitHub Copilot extension for defining and managing engineering workflows

commands.title: Run Loop
commands.description: Start a runner process for the selected loop

commands.title: Cancel Run
commands.description: Cancel an active run by run ID

commands.title: Submit Approval Decision
commands.description: Submit approve, reject, or defer decision for a paused run

commands.title: Get Run Status
commands.description: Query run status by run ID

commands.title: Open Run Summary
commands.description: Open machine and human-readable summary reports for a run

commands.title: Open Worktree Location
commands.description: Reveal worktree location for isolated runs

commands.title: Inspect Branch Status
commands.description: Inspect git branch status for the run execution context

commands.title: Open Step Evidence
commands.description: Open stdout, stderr, or metadata artifacts for a run step

commands.title: Open Timeline Deep Link
commands.description: Navigate from a run timeline entry to diagnostics, tests, diffs, or logs

commands.title: Open Deep Link Target
commands.description: Open a specific deep-link target from a timeline action

commands.title: Open Artifact
commands.description: Open an artifact from the Evidence explorer

commands.title: Reveal Artifact
commands.description: Reveal an artifact in the OS file explorer

commands.title: Huckleberry: Debug Welcome View
commands.description: Debug why the explorer welcome view is not showing

commands.title: Huckleberry: Debug TreeView Properties
commands.description: Inspect TreeView properties to troubleshoot welcome view issues

chatParticipants.name: Huckleberry
chatParticipants.description: An assistant that helps manage engineering workflows and project execution

view/item/context.when: view == huckleberryRunsView && (viewItem == run-succeeded-workspace || viewItem == run-failed-workspace || viewItem == run-cancelled-workspace || viewItem == run-exhausted-workspace || viewItem == run-succeeded-worktree || viewItem == run-failed-worktree || viewItem == run-cancelled-worktree || viewItem == run-exhausted-worktree || viewItem == run-succeeded-unknown || viewItem == run-failed-unknown || viewItem == run-cancelled-unknown || viewItem == run-exhausted-unknown)

view == huckleberryRunsView && (viewItem == run-running-worktree || viewItem == run-paused-worktree || viewItem == run-succeeded-worktree || viewItem == run-failed-worktree || viewItem == run-cancelled-worktree || viewItem == run-exhausted-worktree)

view == huckleberryRunsView && (viewItem == run-running-worktree || viewItem == run-paused-worktree || viewItem == run-succeeded-worktree || viewItem == run-failed-worktree || viewItem == run-cancelled-worktree || viewItem == run-exhausted-worktree)

viewsWelcome.contents:
$(repo) No loops found yet.

Create workflow files under `.huckleberry/loops` to populate this view.

[$(new-file) Create Starter Templates](command:vscode-copilot-huckleberry.loops.createStarterTemplates)
[$(book) Quick Start](https://github.com/CambridgeMonorail/vscode-huckleberry/blob/main/apps/huckleberry-docs/docs/quick-start.md)
[$(refresh) Refresh Loops](command:vscode-copilot-huckleberry.loops.refresh)

$(history) No runs yet.

Run history and evidence timelines will appear here once loop execution is available.

[$(book) Troubleshooting](https://github.com/CambridgeMonorail/vscode-huckleberry/blob/main/apps/huckleberry-docs/docs/runner-troubleshooting.md)
[$(refresh) Refresh Runs](command:vscode-copilot-huckleberry.runs.refresh)

$(files) No evidence artifacts yet.

Artifacts are grouped by run, step, and category after loop execution.

[$(book) Evidence Model Guide](https://github.com/CambridgeMonorail/vscode-huckleberry/blob/main/apps/huckleberry-docs/docs/evidence-model-guide.md)
[$(refresh) Refresh Evidence](command:vscode-copilot-huckleberry.evidence.refresh)
